newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iraq in big new wheat deal with France.
newsitem.headline: Iraq in big new wheat deal with France.

text.p: Iraq has finalised contracts to buy wheat from France worth almost $50 million under the oil-for-food deal it struck with the United Nations, traders reported on Wednesday.
Contracts covered between 250,000 and 275,000 tonnes of French wheat for March and April delivery at prices between $184 and $185 per tonne, the European grain traders said.
The price includes cost and freight, they said.
Iraq is buying grain now that the United Nations has eased its Gulf War embargo on its oil exports under an accord that lets it use the money to buy food and medicine.
